card.name: Page references and section numbers
card.fires_on: Marks the word 'page' or a page-number slot in web text and citations, such as the colon after 'Page' or the 'p' before a page range. It also fires on the digit after '1' in label section cross-references like (12.3) or (13.1).

modes.label: Page and citation
modes.description: The word page, or the 'p' before a page range in a reference.

modes.label: Section cross-reference digit
modes.description: The second digit of a numbered label section reference, such as 12.3 or 13.1, in parentheses.

card.writes: No clear output effect; the promoted and suppressed tokens look unrelated to each other and to the pattern.
card.plain: It lights up on page mentions, page numbers in citations, and the digits inside section cross-references like 12.3.
